title: HRC CSP Climbs to $1,135 as Lead Times Continue To Extend: What It Means for Steel Buyers
content:
The CSP HRC base price rose $5/ton to $1,135/ton for the week of July 13, ending a two-week pause after backlog and lead times proved they could support further increases. HRC lead times extended to 7.4 weeks, zinc climbed for the eleventh time in thirteen weeks, and coking coal remains well above its late-February level despite a three-week pullback.
